About the League

COBL x Street 11 Basketball is a recreational basketball league in Singapore built by players, for players. More than just a place to compete, COBL is a community where passion for basketball brings people together, friendships are built, and brotherhood grows both on and off the court.

We believe every player deserves the opportunity to compete, improve, and be recognized. That’s why we bring every game day to life with live scoreboards, real-time statistics, and broadcast-style coverage, capturing every play, every milestone, and every moment that makes the game special.

From the opening tip-off to the final buzzer, every game matters. Every player has a story, every team has something to prove, and every point counts.

COBL is more than basketball. It’s about community, competition, and brotherhood.

Tournament Format

From a single round-robin to best-of-3 finals: every team plays every other team, then the top 8 fight through a best-of-3 playoff bracket for the Season 3 crown.

Stage 1

Single Group Round-Robin

  • All 11 teams in one group, each playing every other team once
  • 55 total games
  • Top 8 advance to the playoffs
  • Bottom 3 are eliminated
Stage 2

Playoff Bracket

  • Quarterfinals and semifinals are best-of-3
  • The league championship is a best-of-3 finals
  • Losing semifinalists meet in a single-game 3rd place match

Quarterfinals

Best-of-3

Seed 1 vs Seed 8 (QF1)Seed 4 vs Seed 5 (QF2)Seed 2 vs Seed 7 (QF3)Seed 3 vs Seed 6 (QF4)

Semifinals

Best-of-3

Winner QF1 vs Winner QF2 (SF1)Winner QF3 vs Winner QF4 (SF2)

Finals

Best-of-3 for the league championship

Winner SF1 vs Winner SF2

3rd Place

Single game

Loser SF1 vs Loser SF2

🏆 Season 3 MVP Race

Who will wear the crown?

Every game counts. The MVP race updates after every game from our live stats. Watch the leaders battle for the top spot.

The race starts at tip-off. The MVP ladder appears after the first games are played.
1. EfficiencyPlayers are ranked by average EFF per game: points + rebounds + assists + steals + blocks, minus missed shots, missed free throws and turnovers.
2. Games playedA player must play a minimum number of games to qualify for the MVP award.
3. Fair playTechnical fouls and unsportsmanlike conduct count against a player, and can disqualify.
4. Final decisionThe COBL Committee confirms the Season 3 MVP at the end of the season, considering team success.

New to COBL?

Rookies, this is your shot

Never played in COBL Season 1 or Season 2? Join the league as a rookie and chase the Rookie of the Season award. Show the league what you’ve got!

🏀 Balanced teams through the draft📊 Live stats on every game🎥 Broadcast-style coverage🤝 A community that has your back
Who is a rookie?Any player who did not play in COBL Season 1 or Season 2.
How it’s rankedAverage EFF per game, the same formula as the MVP race, among rookies only.
Minimum gamesRookies must play at least 3 games to qualify.
The winnerThe COBL Committee confirms the Rookie of the Season at the end of the season.
